美ら花 別邸.name: Churahana Bettei
美ら花 別邸.desc: A shop I met through the “Nago City Soba Map,” the starting point of my Okinawa soba journey (13.5/15). A creative style with ramen-like house-made extra-thin noodles × a golden broth simmered for 5 hours. The signature is the ingredient-packed “vegetable soba.” It also appeared on Bananaman's Sekkaku Gourmet.
t: I ate at a shop I found through the “Nago City Soba Map,” which started my Okinawa soba journey, in September 2020 ☺
The “Nago City Soba Map” was what got me into going around Okinawa soba shops. At first I relied on this map to visit Okinawa soba shops in Nago City, lol
“Churahana” is along Route 58, so it's easy to find.
When I checked Twitter, it seems this was the 10th shop since I started going around Okinawa soba shops. Nostalgic 😁

Nago City soba tour, No. 10〜 Vegetable soba at “Churahana.” House-made? ramen-like extra-thin noodles with a rich broth. Lots of vegetables on top of an egg omelet, packed with toppings and delicious. An original Okinawa soba that's new to me. I recommend this one at least once ^_^ Finally reached double digits in my eating tour. I'll do my best to conquer them all 💪— Anji (@UisDnbFwbMz5xjm), from a tweet on September 29, 2020
Actually, this shop was introduced on “Bananaman's Sekkaku Gourmet (Nago City edition)” broadcast on August 28, 2022, but it appeared not for Okinawa soba but for “chicken wings & fu champuru” ^^;
On the show, “Kou-chan Soba” appeared as the Okinawa soba, but personally I think Churahana's “vegetable soba” is more delicious than that, so I recommend it.
It was a creative-style Okinawa soba like ramen. The “vegetable soba” that was introduced with a photo on the soba map

The house-made noodles are extra-thin like ramen. They apparently use an original blend of wheat flour and mineral-rich Okinawan salt. The smooth, firm taste unique to fresh noodles struck me as a new creative-style Okinawa soba unlike any before.

The toppings were generous vegetables on top of an egg omelet and delicious. The soba broth is said to be a golden broth made by slowly simmering aromatic vegetables, pork, and chicken for over 5 hours, and the broth was delicious too.

Rating (13.5/15): It's a creative-style Okinawa soba, and tastes may vary, but I recommend this one at least once too. Next I'd like to try a different kind too, but since I also want to go around all the soba shops on the Okinawa main island, who knows when, lol

花はな商店.name: Hanahana Shoten
花はな商店.desc: A shop particular even about its water, with special fresh noodles kneaded with fish powder and aged 48 hours for a firm texture. The signature Mixed Soba, with low-temperature-cooked whitish meat and 2 quail eggs, has a character found at no other shop.
t: I ate here in November 2023. This shop is a participating shop in the “13th Okinawa Soba Stamp Rally (2023.10.1–2024.2.29),” and I went as the 16th of 34 shops 😊
Hanahana Shoten (there is no parking lot, so you need to use a nearby coin parking lot.)
On the wall inside the shop was an explanation of their commitment to soba 😊

Inside the shop, a note explaining their commitment to the soba was posted. Also, when I googled it, there was an explanation saying “Specially made fresh noodles with an original blend of wheat flour and fish powder kneaded in and aged for 48 hours. Firm and smooth going down,” which sounds delicious 😁

There was also an explanation about the water: “With a water purifier using 2 types of antibacterial activated carbon, free residual chlorine is removed while leaving the mineral content in the raw water. Furthermore, with a water softener with high filtration capacity, advanced chlorine is removed. Safe and secure ‘delicious water’ is used and served for the broth, boiling the noodles, and drinking water, all.” They're particular about water too, which sounds delicious.
The broth is said to be extracted over 5 hours from domestic pork bones, Hidaka kelp, and domestic bonito flakes with aromatic vegetables. That sounds delicious too 😊
The meat is also cooked at low temperature for a gentle flavor, they say. This too is different from other shops, so I'm looking forward to it, lol
The ticket machine at the entrance. Cash only is a pity; I'd like them to support cashless.
At the ticket machine, I decided to order the “Mixed Soba” introduced in the stamp rally booklet.
Mixed soba　¥900 (topping of fuchiba (mugwort) is a free service)

First, a sip of the blended broth of pork, kelp, and bonito, for which they're even particular about the water. A gentle flavor with the bonito stock of the blended broth coming through strongly. Just plain tasty 🙂
Mixed soba　¥900
Next I tried the medium-thin straight special fresh noodles with fish powder. The noodles feel a little firm and hard.
They reminded me of the fresh noodles at “Ishigufu” and “Chodegwa.” They're similarly firm and hard, so preferences may divide depending on the person.

The braised pork belly (sanmai-niku) and pork spare ribs (soki) toppings are a whitish color not found at other shops, perhaps because of low-temperature cooking. They were tender and lightly seasoned. Only a little shows in the photo, but there were 2 quail eggs, and this topping isn't found at other shops.
Rating (9/15): It's just plain tasty. The noodles are firm and hard, so preferences may differ depending on the person.
* The shop has no parking lot, so you will need to park at a nearby coin parking lot.

茶話乃屋.name: Chawanoya
茶話乃屋.desc: A hideaway mokkai soba (wood-ash lye) shop set back from Route 58, surrounded by fields in the mountain valleys of Nago (with an attached folk museum). The house-made wood-ash noodles are medium-thin noodles with a faint wood-ash flavor. Mugwort soba too. You can eat in a quiet atmosphere.
t: It was introduced on the “Nago City Soba Map” and I ate here in January 2021 😄
Chawanoya (go in off Route 58)
On the “Nago Soba Map,” “Chawanoya” was introduced as shop 34 of 41
Braised pork belly soba (sanmai-niku soba)　¥700

I ordered the “braised pork belly soba” introduced on the map. A bonito-broth soup with particular medium-thin noodles made with house-made wood ash, and the wood-ash flavor faintly wafted, so I enjoyed it 😀 The braised pork belly was also well-seasoned, tender, and delicious 😋
Rating (9/15): The shop is set back from Route 58, surrounded by fields, and you can eat in a very quiet atmosphere 😄 It's just plain tasty, so why not give it a try?

薫風.name: Kunpu
薫風.desc: A noodle shop in Onan, Nago City, particular about house-made noodles. The ¥600 “mugwort soba,” with impressive green flat noodles kneaded with mugwort, has a light pork-bone × bonito broth and the aroma of extra fuchiba. Its affordability is a charm too.
t: It was introduced on the “Nago City Soba Map” and I ate here in September 2020 😄
Kunpu
Kunpu
On the “Nago Soba Map,” “Kunpu” was introduced as shop 8 of 41
The map touted mugwort, so I ordered the “mugwort soba”
Mugwort soba　¥600

The green flat noodles kneaded with mugwort are impactful, lol The broth, a blend of pork bone and bonito stock?, is the light kind. The toppings include extra fuchiba (mugwort) and braised pork belly 😄 When you eat it, the aroma of fuchiba rises, and the quirkiness is irresistible. Delicious.

Rating (9/15): The mugwort soba I had this time is a reasonable ¥600, and when I googled it, the other menu items also seem cheap; they're particular about house-made noodles, yet I think it's relatively cheaper than other shops.
PS: There is no parking lot, so this time I parked at the nearby gymnasium parking lot, lol m(_ _)m

謝苅そば.name: Jagaru Soba
謝苅そば.desc: A popular shop on the heights of Chatan where you can see the sea in the distance from the counter. A light bonito-broth soup with a choice of boiled or fresh noodles, and large, tender soki. Lots of autographs from Kings players too.
t: I ate here in August 2022 😊
Jagaru Soba
Since I went at lunchtime, there was a line of customers. The parking lot in front of the shop was full, so I parked at the “Jagaru Park” parking lot across the street and walked a little to enter 😊
This time I ordered the “Jagaru Soba,” which shares the shop's name.
Jagaru soba (fresh noodles), medium　¥650

A light bonito-broth soup, with noodles you can choose between “boiled noodles” and “fresh noodles,” and I chose fresh noodles. The soki is tender and large. Because the shop is on the heights of Chatan Town, from the counter seats you get a view of the sea far away (around Mihama) 😊
From the counter seats you can see the sea in the distance, lol
Also, inside the shop it's full of autographs of players of the B.League (basketball) Ryukyu Golden Kings and of entertainers 😁 It was a line again today, so it's a popular shop.

Rating (10/15): Both the fresh noodles and the broth are just plain tasty, but unfortunately the time from ordering to serving was by far the slowest of all the shops I've eaten at so far (T_T) Other shops also had lines, but food came out relatively quickly after ordering, so Jagaru Soba's slowness stood out, which I thought was a pity.
